method: Phase 2 adversarial: V5 deletion, R2/V2 prevalence, ship-gate posture, V11 restore, center correction; suite check-threat-claims.py OK + 6/6 selftest

suiteState.check: OK — 7 assets, 3 primary risks, 16 findings, 15 required properties, T1..T11 clean

V5_realDeletion.question: V5 real deletion under content-addressed dedup still UNSOLVED?
V5_realDeletion.answer: YES — unsolved. residualRisks explicitly: 'R5's real deletion is hard under content-addressed deduplication and has not been designed.' v3 advances inventory/enumeration obligations but does not design CAS-safe purge. This is the one structural hole that blocks honest privacy product claims (together with unqualified gates).
V5_realDeletion.posture: Correctly left open. Must not be paper-sealed. Build may implement data inventory first; purge-for-real needs a dedicated design (refcounts + exclusive-owner delete, or copy-on-write per project, or encrypted-per-project keys destroyed on purge).

R2_V2.question: R2 sync/backup detection unverified; V2 prevalence ASSERTED?
R2_V2.answer: CONFIRM. Mechanism (refuse on detection) does not require prevalence. Word 'commonly' in V2 title/detail is still not evidence — evidenceGrade ASSERTED is correct. R2 MECHANISM UNVERIFIED against real clients is honest. Before ship of refuse-path: exercise marker detection against real Dropbox/iCloud/OneDrive/Time Machine layouts or drop absolute language.

shipGateNoQualified.question: No QUALIFIED gate ⇒ no privacy/offline claim — correct or paralysing?
shipGateNoQualified.answer: CORRECT, not paralysing. Publishing sandbox/isolation/offline claims without observed-failure gates is how tools earn distrust. Architecture may be built; *marketing claims* blocked until operability qualifies gates. That is the right consumer-B posture for a tool granted full source read.
shipGateNoQualified.paralysisRisk: If QUALIFIED is defined so nothing can qualify pre-production, the first release cannot claim offline even when network is blocked in tests. Mitigate: allow QUALIFIED from adversarial test harnesses in CI (observed failure of a deliberate egress attempt), not only production incidents.

centerCorrection.question: PROTECT THE USER FROM OPENSIP-CLI?
centerCorrection.answer: Right center for single-user local CLI. Enterprise multi-tenant adversaries correctly CONDITIONAL. Solo author residual remains (same author as contracts) — second review helps but is not multi-party threat modeling.

V11.question: Secret-value finding restored?
V11.answer: YES — V11 + R11 absolute. Closes A1-TM2-01 / resolved-inputs CFG-6 rooting gap for TM.

findings.title: V5 real deletion under CAS dedup remains undesigned
findings.evidence: V5 requiredMitigations demand purge that DELETES content; residualRisks admit not designed; R5 primary gate with no design artifact.
findings.impact: Any privacy claim that 'you can delete what we hold' is false under naive CAS GC. Users cannot verify U6.
findings.requiredChange: Either (a) design CAS-safe real deletion (project-keyed encryption with key destruction, or non-deduped private store for source-derived classes, or refcount+zero-copy-proof) before sealing R5 as implementable, or (b) narrow R5 to 'enumerate + best-effort deref with EXPLICIT residual that bytes may remain until global GC' and demote 'delete for real' from absolute language. (a) preferred for trust.
findings.whatWouldChangeMyMind: A written deletion design that survives content-addressed sharing across projects/sessions with a conformance test.

findings.title: R2 detection unverified against real sync clients
findings.evidence: R2 evidenceGrade MECHANISM UNVERIFIED; V2 prevalence ASSERTED; residualRisks novel/corporate sync tools.
findings.impact: Refuse path may miss real sync roots (false sense of safety) or false-positive refuse on exotic layouts.
findings.requiredChange: Before shipping refuse-on-detect: fixture corpus of real client marker paths; document non-exhaustiveness in UX at refuse time.
findings.whatWouldChangeMyMind: Verified marker matrix for top-N sync/backup tools on macOS/Linux/Windows.

findings.title: Ship-gate QUALIFIED bar needs a pre-production qualification path
findings.evidence: shipGate currentState: no requiredProperty has qualified gate because no implementation exists.
findings.impact: Strict reading blocks all privacy/offline claims until production observed failures — too late for first honest docs.
findings.requiredChange: Clarify that QUALIFIED may be earned by controlled adversarial tests (e.g. network-blocked run proving R1) under operability definition, not only field incidents.
findings.whatWouldChangeMyMind: Operability already defines observed failure to include harness failures — if so, document the cross-link explicitly in TM shipGate.

findings.title: Solo authorship of TM and the contracts it cross-checks
findings.requiredChange: This review + Reviewer 2 on other surfaces partially diversifies. Optional external threat pass later.
findings.whatWouldChangeMyMind: Independent threat model from a third party.

sealRecommendation.blocker: R1-TM-01: V5/R5 deletion design or honest narrowing before any path that would let R5 be treated as DISCHARGED. Model as threat *model* may seal its findings list with residual explicit; do not seal R5 implementability.
sealRecommendation.note: Center correction, V11, ship-gate honesty, V15 execution criticality are good. Seal the *risk framing* after V5 residual is either designed or language-narrowed; keep all gates unqualified until implementation+harness.
